# Karol Digital

> Karol Digital builds fast, conversion-focused websites for UK service businesses that want more qualified enquiries, clearer messaging, and stronger online credibility.

## About

Karol Digital is a London-based web design and digital agency serving service businesses across the United Kingdom. We specialise in trust-building websites, technical SEO, AI search optimisation (GEO), content systems, interactive lead magnets, and analytics that show what is driving enquiries.

- Website: https://www.karoldigital.co.uk
- Contact: https://www.karoldigital.co.uk/contact
- Book a consultation: https://www.karoldigital.co.uk/book
- Email: info@karoldigital.co.uk
- Phone: 07565 472445
- Location: London, United Kingdom

## Core services

- [Web Design](https://www.karoldigital.co.uk/services/web-design): Professional websites built for trust, clarity, and lead generation.
- [Custom Web Development](https://www.karoldigital.co.uk/services/custom-web-development): Tailored builds shaped around how the business sells.
- [Next.js Development](https://www.karoldigital.co.uk/services/nextjs-development): High-performance modern websites.
- [Website Audits](https://www.karoldigital.co.uk/services/website-audits): Practical reviews of performance, SEO, UX, and conversions.
- [AI Search Optimisation (GEO)](https://www.karoldigital.co.uk/services/ai-search-optimisation): Structured data, answer-ready content, and visibility in AI search engines.
- [Digital Marketing](https://www.karoldigital.co.uk/services/digital-marketing): SEO, content, and visibility support.
- [Social Media Setup](https://www.karoldigital.co.uk/services/social-media): Professional profile and branding setup.
- [AI Logo Design](https://www.karoldigital.co.uk/services/ai-logo-design): Fast brand identity support.

## AI growth tools

- [GEO & SEO Website Checker](https://www.karoldigital.co.uk/tools/website-checker): Free homepage snapshot of titles, schema, robots.txt, and llms.txt.
- [AI Search Readiness Scorecard](https://www.karoldigital.co.uk/tools/ai-search-scorecard): Free interactive assessment of AI search readiness.
- [Content Brief Generator](https://www.karoldigital.co.uk/tools/content-brief): Free SEO content brief builder for service businesses.
